firm_data.firm_description: Vouté, Lohrfink, McAndrew & Meisner, LLP has built an unsurpassed reputation for aggressive defense of professionals, corporations, municipalities, healthcare organizations and individuals in State and Federal courts in the New York metropolitan area. The depth and breadth of our litigation experience inspires the respect of clients, opposing counsel and judges alike.
notable_facts: Firm has been operating for more than 60 years.
The firm defends professionals, corporations, and healthcare organizations.
The firm practices in State and Federal courts in the New York metropolitan area.

email.subject: AI for Vouté, Lohrfink, McAndrew & Meisner, LLP - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Michael,

With 60+ years defending professionals, corporations, and healthcare organizations across State and Federal courts in the New York metro area, your firm handles the complexity that demands precision.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now expanding regionally. I'd be happy to stop by your White Plains office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping litigation and professional liability firms compete with larger competitors.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
